title: Grand Blue Season 3

thread.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 • Grand Blue Season 3 - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: The dominant reaction is that the episode was extremely funny, with many commenters praising its escalating absurdity and comedic timing.
Several commenters enjoyed the increased focus on the supporting male cast and their ridiculous personalities.
Some viewers found the character-focused material entertaining and appreciated the relationship-related comedy.
A few commenters questioned the episode’s structure, especially the delayed opening and whether the largely comedic material felt like filler.
Some reactions suggested that the sexualized visual humor was excessive or unnecessary, even when the surrounding comedy landed.
